inputs: IDMS FLEETSCH via FLEETSS2: EMPLOYEE (area sweep EMP-REGION), ASSIGNMENT (EMP-ASSIGN), VEHICLE (VEH-ASSIGN owner), MILEAGE-CLAIM (EMP-CLAIM), BENEFIT-PERIOD (CALC)
batch_steps.what_it_does: For every EMPLOYEE occurrence in db-key order, skip if EM-HIRE > BP-END or (EM-LEAV<>0 and < BP-STRT); 2100: first EMP-ASSIGN member with AS-STRT <= BP-END (only one assignment per employee), if AS-END=0 or >= BP-STRT days = min(BP-END, AS-END, EM-LEAV) - max(AS-STRT,BP-STRT) + 1, taxable = (VH-LIST*VH-BPCT/1200 - EM-CNTRB)*days/period-days floored at 0 (no ROUNDED); 2200: sum approved MC-MILES in period and per-claim ROUNDED MC-MILES*BP-MRATE; 2300: write BENOUT + report line if days>0 or miles>0, flag L if EM-LEAV in period; 9000: totals line, FINISH. Any other DB status -> IDMS-ABORT RC=16, ROLLBACK, STOP RUN. Does not check BP-STAT or EM-STAT or EM-GRD or AS-RSN.

unreached.item: EM-SURN, EM-FORN, EM-GRD, EM-CC, EM-STAT, VH-PLATE, VH-MAKE, VH-MODL, AS-RSN, BP-STAT (batch side)
unreached.why_unreached: FLEBEN01 never tests them: transferred (X)/terminated (T) employees, grade<07 holders and PL loans all get benefit; period status not checked though header says closed period. In the unload all 26 T/X occurrences carry EM-LEAV, so in the data they are only paid up to the leaving date.

unreached.item: FLEUNLD 'OWNER EMP-VEHICLE KEY AND DBKEY' under FLEETSS2
unreached.why_unreached: EMP-VEHICLE is not in FLEETSS2 (only in FLEETSS1), so as written the unload clause names a set its subschema lacks; yet VEHICLE.dat carries owners (101 set).

unreached.item: FLEASGN-ENTER 'VEHICLE ALREADY HELD' for pool cars
unreached.why_unreached: PL assignments never CONNECT to EMP-VEHICLE, so EMP-VEHICLE MEMBER is false for a car out on pool loan; a pool-loaned car can be re-assigned. Also no check that the employee already holds a car (unload: 20 employees with 2 open assignments).

ENTER re-OBTAINs EMPLOYEE without DB-REC-NOT-FOUND or EM-GRD test; premap enforces grade by clearing WK-EMPID, but ENTER runs on edit errors and does not re-check (unload: 9 assignments held by grade<07 employees (7 at grade 05, 2 at grade 06)).

unreached.item: WHILE EM-STAT EQ 'T' loops without not-found exit
unreached.why_unreached: In FLEASGN-ENTER, FLEMILE-PREMAP and FLEMILE-ENTER the loop has no DB-REC-NOT-FOUND test: an employee whose only/last occurrence is T loops on a 0326 status (behaviour depends on ADS autostatus). Only FLEASGN-PREMAP and FLEEMPI-PREMAP exit with 'EMPLOYEE HAS LEFT'.
MC-MILES has EDIT PICTURE 9(5) REQUIRED; reachable only because the response runs on edit errors (EXECUTE ON EDIT ERRORS) with a zero value.
FILE STATUS declared but never tested.

unreached.item: FLEBEN01 2100 'IF WS-DAYS = 0 MOVE SPACES TO BO-VEHID' vs earlier branches
unreached.why_unreached: Reachable (leaver before car start, no car in period); note BO-VEHID is set before the WS-DAYS>0 test, so this blanks it. Listed to record that it is NOT dead.
Loop stops at first EMP-ASSIGN member with AS-STRT<=BP-END; any other overlapping assignment (second car, earlier car returned mid-period) is never evaluated.
